HeaderEvent.description: Up to 18 event times together with a four-character label and a status (either ON or OFF) for each defined event.

on.description: The event status: ON (true) or OFF (false).

description: The integer words of the C3D 3D Point header record and its header events. The floating-point words 7-8 (3D scale factor) and 11-12 (3D frame rate) are not encoded: the encoding translator has no floating-point type. For the same reason the event times are not encoded.

analogSamplesPer3dFrame.description: Word 10: the number of analog samples associated with each 3D frame.

analogSamplesPerFrame.description: Word 3: the number of analog samples stored with each frame of data.

dataStart.description: Word 9: a copy of DATA_START, the first 512-byte block of the 3D point and analog data section.

events.description: Words 150-234: header word 151 stores the number of events, between 0 and 18.

formatIdentifier.description: Word 1, second byte: normally 0x50 (ASCII P), the 3D Point data format.

maximumInterpolationGap.description: Word 6: the maximum interpolation gap length for 3D Point data.

parameterBlock.description: Word 1, first byte: points to the 512-byte block that starts the parameter section.

pointCount.description: Word 2: the number of trajectories stored in each frame as 3D points, a copy of POINT:USED.

title: C3D header section
